title: Swimming across a flowing river
caption: Aiming straight across at 1.5 m s⁻¹ while the river flows at 0.9 m s⁻¹, the swimmer moves at 1.75 m s⁻¹, 31° downstream of straight across. Crossing 60 m takes 40 s, so the river carries them 36 m downstream.
alt: Vector triangle: 1.5 metres per second across, 0.9 downstream, and a resultant of 1.75 at 31 degrees downstream.
description: The swimmer's velocity relative to the water: 1.5 m s⁻¹ straight across.
The water's velocity: 0.9 m s⁻¹ downstream, drawn from the tip.
Resultant: √(1.5² + 0.9²) = 1.75 m s⁻¹, at tan⁻¹(0.9/1.5) = 31° downstream.
